title: BTS ARIRANG World Tour Night 2 at Allegiant Stadium Las Vegas — AMA Appearance Set for Tomorrow
detail: BTS performs the second of four sold-out nights at Allegiant Stadium (65,000 capacity) in Las Vegas on May 24, 2026, continuing the ARIRANG World Tour's historic Las Vegas residency. Following the triumphant Night 1 opening on May 23, Night 2 brings another capacity crowd, with the 360-degree in-the-round stage delivering the full ARIRANG production across 23 songs. The Las Vegas Review-Journal and local outlets continue documenting the extraordinary ARMY convergence — the city's resorts, attractions, and nightlife venues have welcomed BTS fans in record numbers since the 'BTS: The City Arirang' festival opened May 20. The Las Vegas Sphere Exosphere ARIRANG visuals continue through May 28; all citywide activations remain live. Tomorrow (May 25, Memorial Day), BTS makes a special appearance at the 52nd American Music Awards at the MGM Grand Garden Arena — their first US award show appearance in approximately four years. BTS holds three nominations: Artist of the Year, Song of the Summer ('SWIM'), and Best Male K-Pop Artist. After Night 2, the tour resumes with Night 3 on May 27 and Night 4 on May 28 — completing the full four-night Las Vegas engagement before the ARIRANG World Tour's next international leg.

title: 'SWIM' Slips to No. 5 on US Billboard Hot 100 but Holds Global Top 3 for 6th Consecutive Week
detail: In the latest Billboard chart cycle (chart dated approximately May 24, 2026), BTS's 'SWIM' slips to No. 5 on the US Billboard Hot 100 — the primary US singles chart — from its earlier peak of No. 1, reflecting natural normalization of US streaming and radio after sustained dominance. Simultaneously, 'SWIM' maintains a position within the Billboard Global 200 top 3 for a sixth consecutive week, demonstrating continued strong international streaming performance. Korea Herald reports that SWIM's six straight weeks in the global top 3 represents a K-pop record for sustained global singles chart presence. The ARIRANG album continues on the Billboard 200 in its 9th week of top-5 presence — the longest any K-pop album has charted in the Billboard 200 top 5. All 13 vocal tracks from ARIRANG remain active on global charts. The chart movements coincide with BTS's Las Vegas ARIRANG World Tour residency, where Night 2 of four sold-out Allegiant Stadium shows takes place tonight.

media.caption: BTS 'SWIM' holds global top 3 for sixth straight week — a K-pop record for sustained global singles chart presence
